narrative: Trump's June 2 order builds a frontier-model cyber-capability benchmarking process, designates "covered frontier models," and offers a strictly voluntary up-to-30-day pre-release access framework that procurement leverage gives mandatory pull - a concrete federal shape labs can converge their disclosures toward, matching the predicted voluntary alignment, though scoped to cyber capability rather than broad catastrophic risk.
remaining_gap: No over-threshold lab has yet published a framework update citing the federal shape, and the order's cyber scope is narrower than catastrophic-risk disclosure.
